Description.DefaultText: Hidden clamped marker for reporting a Market Stall robbery to the Watch, one open report at a time: 0 = none, 1 = a stolen item waits to be reported, 2 = reported and waiting for the due day, 3 = the Watch found it and it comes back on your next visit to the Village, 4 = the Watch found nothing and a guard will say so. Never a counter: the stall robbery sets 1, a guard's Talk line sets 2, the recovery check sets 3 or 4, and delivery or the guard's 'not found' line puts it back to 0.
